items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: I said yeah, because I only had to play in the pit was castinet, triangle, bass drum, snake drum and wood block... I'd never did that before, but at the time I was studying up at Julliard... I was used to following a conductor

ctx.x: Oh yeah, they're bootlegging them like the devil yes. I look at a lot of my Carmen things.
I see them on labels that I don't even know. Like that Cozy Conception of Carmen.
Hold on a second. I just handed Cozy a copy of a record--it's now on Everest Records, and it was originally called Cozy's Conception of Carmen. For what label?
